files.description: Post-migration positions with real Jupiter fills, plus ex-ante features (liquidity, buyers, creator history, dev buy, social presence).
Exit-policy grid evaluated on the same positions: each row is one (position, exit configuration) pair with its realised return.
Liquidity, price, FDV and 24h flow series per tracked position.
Real exit slippage, order by order: quoted output vs mark-to-market.
Entry overhead, order by order: fill price vs decision price. Sanitized -- wallet and signature removed.
Independent survivor-strategy evaluations. Joins to the graduation population by mint, enabling the cross-strategy condition.
Post-migration price trajectories: one row per (mint, seconds since migration, price). The raw shape behind every outcome above.
